title: 軌旁落石與異物偵測~Trackside rockfall and obstruction detection
focus: 異物偵測覆蓋延遲與誤報漏報~Obstruction coverage latency false alarms and missed events
summary: 軌旁落石與異物偵測以「異物偵測覆蓋延遲與誤報漏報」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。軌旁異物偵測要把感測範圍、事件判定與列車防護動作連接，警報延遲和漏檢比漂亮影像更重要，正常訊號不能直接視為安全許可。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。~This course develops obstruction coverage latency false alarms and missed events through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Trackside obstruction detection connects sensing coverage, event decisions and train protection; latency and missed events matter more than attractive images, and a normal signal is not automatically movement permission. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
history: 本課把軌旁落石與異物偵測放在可追溯的技術演進脈絡中，不把機構研究、規範出版與個別路線通車混為一談。軌旁異物偵測要把感測範圍、事件判定與列車防護動作連接，警報延遲和漏檢比漂亮影像更重要，正常訊號不能直接視為安全許可。下列年代欄是工程事件、相關研究或規範出版節點；除明確標明實際工程事件者外，並非本專題設備的製造或投入營運日期。工程改進的判準是能否以量測區分假說，不能只依新舊設備外觀判斷。~The course places Trackside rockfall and obstruction detection in a traceable engineering context and distinguishes institutional research, standards publication and the opening of individual lines. Trackside obstruction detection connects sensing coverage, event decisions and train protection; latency and missed events matter more than attractive images, and a normal signal is not automatically movement permission. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Unless explicitly labelled as a project event, a date is not the manufacture or commissioning date of the equipment. Improvement is assessed by whether measurements distinguish hypotheses, rather than by the apparent age of machinery.
example: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：h=20 m, g=9.81 m/s2；y=sqrt(2*h/g)=2.01928 s。只把 h 增加百分之十，y=2.11783 s。模型邊界：無初速無阻力垂落；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：sense=0.1 s, comm=0.2 s, logic=0.05 s；y=sense+comm+logic=0.35 s。只把 sense 增加百分之十，y=0.36 s。模型邊界：順序處理無重疊；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。~This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: h=20 m, g=9.81 m/s2; y=sqrt(2*h/g)=2.01928 s. Increasing only h with a ten-percent increase gives y=2.11783 s. Boundary: Vertical fall without initial speed or drag; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: sense=0.1 s, comm=0.2 s, logic=0.05 s; y=sense+comm+logic=0.35 s. Increasing only sense with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.36 s. Boundary: Sequential processing without overlap; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.

units.anchor: 落體到達時間~Falling-object arrival time
units.title: 落體到達時間~Falling-object arrival time
units.mechanism: 理想自由落體時間只是事件時間尺度。本模型把 h 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 2.11783 s。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。無初速無阻力垂落。使用合成物體軌跡作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；碰撞反彈與坡面滑動改變到達時間，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Ideal free-fall time is only an event timescale. In this model, h is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 2.11783 s. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Vertical fall without initial speed or drag. Use synthetic object trajectory as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Bounces and slope sliding alter arrival time; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：h=20 m, g=9.81 m/s2；y=sqrt(2*h/g)=2.01928 s。只把 h 增加百分之十，y=2.11783 s。模型邊界：無初速無阻力垂落；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: h=20 m, g=9.81 m/s2; y=sqrt(2*h/g)=2.01928 s. Increasing only h with a ten-percent increase gives y=2.11783 s. Boundary: Vertical fall without initial speed or drag; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以合成物體軌跡區分模型與觀察，先用合成高速影格與時鐘建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「落體到達時間」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use synthetic object trajectory to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synthetic high-speed frames and clock, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Falling-object arrival time. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 碰撞反彈與坡面滑動改變到達時間。這個失效與「落體到達時間」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查合成物體軌跡，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Bounces and slope sliding alter arrival time. This failure and a measurement bias in Falling-object arrival time can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check synthetic object trajectory rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：碰撞反彈與坡面滑動改變到達時間~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Bounces and slope sliding alter arrival time.
units.practice: 重算「落體到達時間」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出無初速無阻力垂落如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由碰撞反彈與坡面滑動改變到達時間造成偏離的合成觀察，以合成物體軌跡說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Falling-object arrival time, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Vertical fall without initial speed or drag. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Bounces and slope sliding alter arrival time. Explain which evidence in synthetic object trajectory distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

units.mechanism: 順序鏈延遲相加且需另查最壞抖動。本模型把 sense 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.36 s。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。順序處理無重疊。使用端到端時間戳作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；平均網路延遲不能保證最壞反應，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Sequential delays add, with worst-case jitter checked separately. In this model, sense is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.36 s. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Sequential processing without overlap. Use end-to-end timestamps as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Mean network latency cannot guarantee worst response; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.

units.anchor: 延遲列車前進量~Train travel during latency
units.title: 延遲列車前進量~Train travel during latency
units.mechanism: 警報鏈延遲消耗可用距離。本模型把 v 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 15.4 m。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。延遲期間等速。使用列車速度和警報時間作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；忽略延遲會高估保護距離，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Alarm-chain delay consumes available distance. units.title: 辨識召回率~Detection recall estimate
units.mechanism: 召回率需要包含未被系統報出的真事件。本模型把 TP 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加一個整數單位，輸出增加為 90.1961 percent。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。具代表性的替代計數資料集，擾動時總樣本數可變。使用盲測真值集作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；只收集警報影片無法估漏檢，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Recall includes true events the system failed to report. In this model, TP is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. An increase of one whole unit means the output increases to 90.1961 percent. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Representative alternative count datasets whose total may change under perturbation. Use blinded ground-truth set as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Alarm clips alone cannot estimate misses; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：TP=45 count, FN=5 count；y=TP/(TP+FN)*100=90 percent。只把 TP 增加一個整數單位，y=90.1961 percent。模型邊界：具代表性的替代計數資料集，擾動時總樣本數可變；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: TP=45 count, FN=5 count; y=TP/(TP+FN)*100=90 percent. Increasing only TP with an increase of one whole unit gives y=90.1961 percent. Boundary: Representative alternative count datasets whose total may change under perturbation; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

units.title: 警報精確率~Alarm precision estimate
units.mechanism: 精確率描述警報中真事件比例。本模型把 TP 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加一個整數單位，輸出增加為 75.4098 percent。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。固定事件定義的替代計數資料集，擾動時警報總數可變。使用全部警報與複核結果作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；高召回可伴隨過多誤報，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Precision describes the true-event fraction among alarms. In this model, TP is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. An increase of one whole unit means the output increases to 75.4098 percent. units.verify: 本單元以天候分層運行紀錄區分模型與觀察，先用事件與天候時間序列建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「測試誤報頻率」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use weather-stratified operating records to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using event and weather time series, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Test false-alarm rate. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 晴天測試不能代表雨霧條件。這個失效與「測試誤報頻率」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查天候分層運行紀錄，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Clear-weather tests do not represent rain and fog. This failure and a measurement bias in Test false-alarm rate can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check weather-stratified operating records rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：晴天測試不能代表雨霧條件~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Clear-weather tests do not represent rain and fog.
units.practice: 重算「測試誤報頻率」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出指定測試環境平均如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由晴天測試不能代表雨霧條件造成偏離的合成觀察，以天候分層運行紀錄說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Test false-alarm rate, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Mean in the specified test environment. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Clear-weather tests do not represent rain and fog. Explain which evidence in weather-stratified operating records distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
